preconditions.description: The input verb must be a string.
The verb must end with one of the valid Spanish infinitive suffixes: 'ar', 'er', or 'ir' (case-insensitive).
The verb must have a stem (length greater than the suffix length).

postconditions.expression: isinstance(return_value, dict) and len(return_value) == 1 and verb.lower() in return_value
postconditions.description: The return value is a dictionary with exactly one key, which is the lowercase version of the input verb.
The value associated with the verb key is a list containing exactly 6 conjugated forms.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(form, str) for form in return_value[verb.lower()])
postconditions.description: All conjugated forms in the list are strings.

postconditions.expression: stem == verb.lower()[:-2] if verb.lower().endswith('ar') else (verb.lower()[:-2] if verb.lower().endswith('er') else verb.lower()[:-2])
postconditions.description: The stem is derived by removing the last two characters of the lowercase verb.

postconditions.expression: suffixes_ar = ['o', 'as', 'a', 'amos', 'áis', 'an'] and suffixes_er = ['o', 'es', 'e', 'emos', 'éis', 'en'] and suffixes_ir = ['o', 'es', 'e', 'imos', 'ís', 'en'] and (verb.lower().endswith('ar') and return_value[verb.lower()] == [stem + s for s in suffixes_ar]) or (verb.lower().endswith('er') and return_value[verb.lower()] == [stem + s for s in suffixes_er]) or (verb.lower().endswith('ir') and return_value[verb.lower()] == [stem + s for s in suffixes_ir])
postconditions.description: The conjugated forms are constructed by appending the correct suffixes for the specific infinitive type (AR, ER, or IR) to the stem, in the order: 1st sing, 2nd sing, 3rd sing, 1st pl, 2nd pl, 3rd pl.
